# Nature-Level Figure Checklist

- The figure has one message, and each panel earns its place.
- Panel labels are consistent: a, b, c or A, B, C.
- Fonts are embedded or convertible; no missing glyphs.
- Text remains readable at final print width.
- Lines are thick enough after scaling.
- Colors survive grayscale and color-vision simulation.
- Axes do not exaggerate effects.
- Legends are minimal; direct labels are preferred where possible.
- Figure caption explains what is shown, not the entire paper.
- The script that generated the figure is saved with data provenance.
